regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative China A-shares tape: Banks (512800.SS) is the sole eligible leader out of 22 themes (breadth 1.0, durable trend, crowded at z 1.85), with Coal a distant second (mean-reverting, breadth 0.5) and everything else ineligible. theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme that is both eligible (absolute-trend gate passed) and the leader in rank, durability (0.83), breadth (1.0) and a trend Hurst tag. Per the guardrails this is a focus/liquidity lens, not a return forecast — but as a directional lean, the concentration of flow into one durable trend theme is the least-contradicted by the state. Crowding (z 1.85) is a size-down caution, not a fade, and I am not treating it as a buy because it leads.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.078, eligible true (only non-Coal eligible theme)
crowding_z 1.85, crowded true (sizing caution, not a signal)
theses.dissent: The backtest verdict is explicit that the absolute-trend gate did not hold on China A-shares — the tape mean-reverts and whipsaws trend followers. A fully-owned, crowded (z 1.85) one-narrative leader is exactly the setup that historically reverses on any attention spike; the detector's own reader_contract warns thematic ETF inflows mark tops.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS trails the CSI 300 by more than 5% before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme and the rotation challenger (score 1.038, margin 0.04 behind Banks). It is not crowded (z 0.72), but its Hurst tag is mean-revert and breadth is a weak 0.5 — less cohesion than Banks. This is a modest second leg only because it cleared the eligibility gate; the mean-revert tag argues against trend-style overweight in a whipsaw tape.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert Hurst tag plus the market-level finding that the trend gate did not reduce drawdown here (gate_helps false) means an eligible trend signal may carry no edge on this tape; Coal's second-place score is 1.038 vs Banks 1.078, a thin margin with only 2 eligible names.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS trails the CSI 300 by more than 5% before the 20-day check-by date.
